newsitem.title: CHINA: Eastern Communications 1996 net up 14.29 pct.
newsitem.headline: Eastern Communications 1996 net up 14.29 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Net asset per share 4.28 yuan vs 1.24
Full company name is Eastern Communications Co Ltd
Note: the results were published in a company statement based on international accounting standards.
Based on domestic accounting standards, 1996 net profit was 322.182 million yuan against 262.474 million yuan in 1995.

The company's board of directors proposed a cash dividend of 0.175 yuan per share for B-share holders and a dividend of 0.048 yuan per share for A-share holders from profits in 1996, pending the approval of a shareholders' meeting, the statement said.
(The company listed its B shares on August 9, 1996 and its A shares on November 26.)
